mapper.sql: a.achievement_id AS "achievementId", a.management_no AS "managementNo", a.teacher_user_id AS "teacherUserId", a.organization_code AS "organizationCode", COALESCE(k.name, u.login_id) AS "teacherName", a.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", a.management_item_code AS "managementItemCode", a.achievement_date AS "achievementDate", a.achievement_name AS "achievementName", a.achievement_detail::text AS "achievementDetail", a.attachment_ids::text AS "attachmentIds", a.achievement_status AS "certificationStatus", a.created_at AS "createdAt", a.created_by AS "createdBy", a.updated_at AS "updatedAt", a.updated_by AS "updatedBy"
FROM education_achievements a JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id LEFT JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots k ON k.employee_no = u.employee_no
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM education_achievements a WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-032' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N'

WHERE a.achievement_id = #{id} AND a.achievement_type = 'FR-032' AND a.deleted_yn = 'N' FOR UPDATE OF a

SELECT m.organization_code FROM organization_user_mappings m WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.mapping_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND m.effective_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND (m.effective_end_date IS NULL OR m.effective_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY m.effective_start_date DESC, m.mapping_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT m.required_yn AS "requiredYn", m.data_type AS "dataType", m.teacher_editable_yn AS "editableYn" FROM evaluation_management_items m JOIN evaluation_elements e ON e.element_id = m.element_id JOIN evaluation_items i ON i.item_id = e.item_id JOIN evaluation_areas a ON a.area_id = i.area_id JOIN evaluation_rule_versions v ON v.rule_version_id = a.rule_version_id WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND e.evaluation_year = #{year} AND e.element_code = 'FR-032' AND a.area_code = 'EDUCATION' AND m.active_yn = 'Y' AND e.active_yn = 'Y' AND i.active_yn = 'Y' AND a.active_yn = 'Y' AND v.version_status = 'CONFIRMED' AND CAST(CONCAT(#{year}, '-01-01') AS date) <= v.effective_end_date AND CAST(CONCAT(#{year}, '-12-31') AS date) >= v.effective_start_date
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE evaluation_finalizations, input_period_settings, evaluation_date_settings, organization_user_mappings, evaluation_organization_mappings, evaluation_management_items, evaluation_elements, evaluation_items, evaluation_areas, evaluation_rule_versions IN SHARE MODE

UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{managementItemCode}, achievement_date = #{achievementDate}, achievement_name = #{achievementName}, attachment_ids = CAST(#{attachmentIds} AS jsonb), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE achievement_id = #{achievementId} AND teacher_user_id = #{actor} AND achievement_type = 'FR-032' AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status = 'DRAFT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_change_histories ( target_business, target_key, change_type, field_name, before_value, after_value, changed_by, change_reason, request_id ) VALUES ('FR-032', CAST(#{id} AS text), #{type}, 'snapshot', #{before}, #{after}, #{actor}, '취업률 실적 저장', #{requestId})

INSERT INTO education_achievement_status_histories ( achievement_type, achievement_id, previous_status, next_status, action_type, opinion, processed_by ) VALUES ('FR-032', #{id}, NULL, 'DRAFT', 'CREATE', '취업률 실적 최초 입력', #{actor})
mapper.select: SELECT j.batch_job_id AS "jobId", j.evaluation_year AS "evaluationYear", j.action_type AS "actionType", j.job_status AS "jobStatus", j.total_count AS "totalCount", j.processed_count AS "processedCount", j.unprocessed_count AS "unprocessedCount", j.target_condition_json::text AS "targetCondition", j.requested_by AS "requestedBy", j.requested_at AS "requestedAt" FROM employment_rate_batch_jobs j WHERE j.batch_job_id = #{id} AND j.requested_by = #{userId}

SELECT b.batch_job_item_id AS "itemId", b.target_user_id AS "targetUserId", b.achievement_id AS "achievementId", b.processed_yn AS "processedYn", b.unprocessed_reason AS "unprocessedReason", b.processed_at AS "processedAt" FROM employment_rate_batch_job_items b JOIN employment_rate_batch_jobs j ON j.batch_job_id = b.batch_job_id WHERE b.batch_job_id = #{id} AND j.requested_by = #{userId} ORDER BY b.batch_job_item_id
